background: BBVA is Spain's second-largest bank, run as a group of self-funded subsidiaries with Mexico the largest earner alongside Spain, Turkey and South America, and a retail and commercial banking focus.
synthesis: Rated A on average across all three, all three on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. Capital is mixed against EU and Nordic banks: CET1 of 13.0% is in the bottom quarter, while leverage of 6.0% is above the peer median but has fallen 0.9 points since 31 Mar 2025. Liquidity sits near the middle, LCR of 142% below the median and NSFR of 125% above it. No rating action has been taken in the last 90 days.
